subject.title: feat(memory): apply temporal decay to QMD search results

question: Should QMD searches honor the existing memorySearch.query.hybrid.temporalDecay setting, including widened QMD candidate windows, for users who already opted into temporal decay?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but it changes ranking semantics for an existing opt-in config path and that compatibility choice needs maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept QMD parity
options.body: Merge the PR as an opt-in consistency fix so temporal decay means the same scoring policy across builtin and QMD backends.

options.title: Keep QMD ranking unchanged
options.body: Do not merge this branch if maintainers want QMD's native raw/reranked ordering to remain independent of the hybrid temporal-decay knob.

options.title: Require a narrower rollout
options.body: Ask for a follow-up design if maintainers want a separate QMD-specific rollout, migration note, or different candidate-window policy before changing rankings.

recommendation.title: Accept QMD parity
recommendation.body: Merge the PR as an opt-in consistency fix so temporal decay means the same scoring policy across builtin and QMD backends.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cross-cutting memory-core and docs history and is best positioned to own the compatibility call.
